scripts.setup:totp-key:
node -e "const fs=require('fs'),crypto=require('crypto'),path=require('path');const envPath=path.resolve(__dirname,'.env');const key=crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');const line='
TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY='+key+'
';if(fs.existsSync(envPath)){const contents=fs.readFileSync(envPath,'utf8');if(contents.includes('TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY=')){console.log('TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY already set in .env — skipping.
To rotate, manually delete the old line and re-run.');process.exit(0);}fs.appendFileSync(envPath,line);}else{fs.writeFileSync(envPath,line);}console.log('✅ TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY written to .env');console.log('⚠  Back up this key — losing it means all TOTP secrets will be unreadable.');"
